outcome_independence_audit.preregistration_principle: An extension rule is statistically valid if and only if it is completely blinded to the experimental outcome (strategy alpha, shortfall difference d_t, or interim p-values).
outcome_independence_audit.extension_trigger_specification: Extension occurs IF AND ONLY IF N_{def} = \sum_{t=1}^{252} \mathbb{I}(R_{m,t} < 0) < 30.
outcome_independence_audit.market_benchmark_definition: R_{m,t} is the daily total return of the benchmark index (SPY).
outcome_independence_audit.outcome_independence_verdict: VERIFIED_OUTCOME_INDEPENDENT. The condition depends entirely on broader market macro volatility, not on D2 or E0 execution, returns, or cumulative p-values.
outcome_independence_audit.anti_peeking_rule: Interim evaluation of d_t or stopping early because p < 0.05 is achieved at session t < 252 is STRICTLY PROHIBITED. Optional stopping inflates Type I error from 5% to > 20%.

power_recalculation_under_serial_depende.analytical_model: One-sided t-test against non-zero hurdle \delta_{min} under AR(1) error persistence
power_recalculation_under_serial_depende.scientific_qualification: These power values are analytical approximations based on Gaussian error assumptions and AR(1) persistence. Real market down-days exhibit fat tails (kurtosis > 5) and jump processes, which may further degrade power. They must NOT be treated as empirical facts.

owner_decision_gate.recommendation: Owner should approve the nominal 252-session horizon with automatic market-dependent extension up to 504 sessions if N_def < 30, while recognizing that 30 observations provides only ~38% power under realistic serial correlation.
